reuse.why: Keeps getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the non-daily case, but writes the daily skip inline in getNextDate rather than inside the shared weekend helper, which every path applying the weekend rule calls.

duplication.why: The isDailyWithSkippedWeekends weekend filter is written twice within the diff (forward and reverse lookups), and the daily rule is not shared with the other weekend paths.

placement.why: The rule is wired into the shared getNextDate, but getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts apply the weekend rule through getDateWithSkippedWeekend themselves and are not updated.

scope.why: Limited to getNextDate and its test, apart from a cosmetic reflow of the reverse occurrences call.

maintainability.why: Taking seven occurrences, filtering twice and switching off the move with a third flag condition is hard to follow, and the daily rule now differs between paths that previously agreed.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate: the daily skip is decided inline and getDateWithSkippedWeekend is bypassed for daily schedules, while other callers of the helper keep moving daily weekend dates

disguised_duplication.where: the repeated filter is a visible copy within getNextDate

one_place.where: only getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts changes; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and both nextDate computations in budget/schedule-template.ts still move daily weekend occurrences through getDateWithSkippedWeekend
